thread:
maria: Heads-up — pushing new installer delta for private/VPC today. Need manifest epoch bump + cosign key rotation. Packaging will build during the 23:00-01:00 PST change window. Please ack if you need a different window.
release-bot: buildkite/job 4521 started: packaging/private-installer-delta (link: https://ci.redwood.dev/4521)
owen: ack. do we have the signed submanifest format finalized? last time we had mismatched manifests causing canary failures.
jia: yes — new submanifest v2.2.0. Added `content_hash` and `signer_id`. We'll attach the signed file to the artifact repo once build completes.
maria: important: DO NOT rotate the shrinkwrap tags during the build. pin `redwood/installer:stable-shrink-2024-11` for the delta.
patrick: canary window? ops-bot said 23:15-23:45 for canary on our staging racks.
ops-bot: Scheduled change window: 2024-11-17 23:00-01:00 PST. Canary: 23:15-23:45. Full rollout: 00:00-00:30. Rollback cutoff: 00:20.
owen: rollback plan — if cosign verification fails in canary, abort and fallback to previously pinned submanifest tag `manifest-20241110` and redeploy — that will be a manual rollback. We need a quick-step checklist.
jia: adding checklist:
```
# verify artifact
sha256sum installer-delta.tar.gz
cosign verify --key $COSIGN_PUB signer-submanifest.json
# validate manifest link graph
python tools/manifest_check.py --manifest signer-submanifest.json
```

I'll push the exact commands to the runbook.
maria: cosign key note — primary KMS key has a TTL refresh scheduled at 23:30. If the rotation job hits during rollout, packaging to attempt secondary signer key `signer-redwood-02`. If both fail, abort and open incident.
owen: noted. Any HSM/PKI contacts on standby?
patrick: @security-team (cc: helen) asked to be on-call. helen: I'm on standby 22:30-01:30.
maria: deployment bot will post a final "version pinned" message before cutover. When you see `deploy-bot: pinned installer -> v2024.11.17-delta` then we cut.
release-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-private-artifacts/installer/v2024.11.17-delta/installer-delta.tar.gz (sha256: abcdef1234...)
jia: uploaded signer-submanifest.json to repo: https://git.redwood.dev/packaging/signer-manifests/commit/0a1b2c
owen: quick question — are we changing default quantization flags in this delta? that's a consumer-facing perf tweak.
maria: no model runtime changes. it's packaging + installer path fixes only.
patrick: if canary looks good, I'll approve full rollout at 23:55. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you have verified checksums.
maria: thanks — will monitor logs from the packaging host. planning to sticky the cosign verify output to the thread.
release-bot: deploy status: canary started on staging-01 at 2024-11-17T23:17:04Z
jia: cosign verify output (staging-01):
```
Verification for signer-submanifest.json : OK
The following checks were performed:
```

owen: saw canary metrics — latency and install success look fine. :thumbsup: 
patrick: giving full rollout go at 23:58. rolling to remaining racks.
ops-bot: Full rollout started 2024-11-18T00:03:12Z. Monitoring.
maria: Post-roll notes: one host failed on post-install due to disk full; file cleared, redeployed, all green. Will open a tiny post-delivery PR to update disk check preflight.
release-bot: final: rollout complete 2024-11-18T00:28:41Z. pinned tag v2024.11.17-delta -> production.
maria: closing thread. Thanks all.
